procedures.title: ADA Compliance Walkthrough
procedures.description: Inspect all handicap parking, ramps, door widths, restroom grab bars, and signage for ADA compliance. Document deficiencies and schedule corrections.

procedures.title: After-Hours Security Incident Response
procedures.description: Respond to alarm activation or security call. Assess threat level, contact police if needed, document incident, notify affected tenants, review camera footage.

procedures.title: Annual Insurance Policy Review
procedures.description: Review property insurance 90 days before renewal. Verify replacement cost values. Check flood zone. Compare 3 quotes. Verify endorsements.

procedures.title: Backflow Preventer Testing
procedures.description: Schedule certified backflow tester for annual testing of all backflow prevention devices. Submit results to LUS within 30 days.

procedures.title: Annual Budget & CAM Reconciliation
procedures.description: Reconcile actual CAM/tax/insurance vs estimates. Calculate over/under for each tenant. Set next year budget. Send reconciliation letters.

procedures.title: CAM/NNN Expense Tracking
procedures.description: Log all common area expenses. Categorize by CAM, tax, or insurance. Update running total for year-end reconciliation.

procedures.title: CAM Reconciliation Letter
procedures.description: Prepare annual CAM reconciliation statement. Show estimated vs actual NNN. Calculate over/under payment. Draft letter.

procedures.title: Security Camera System Check
procedures.description: Verify all cameras recording, check storage capacity, clean lenses, verify night vision, test remote access. Replace any non-functioning cameras.

procedures.title: Certificate of Insurance Tracking
procedures.description: Review all tenant COIs for expiration dates. Send 30-day reminders. Verify coverage meets lease minimums. Flag non-compliant.

procedures.title: Common Area Quick Tidy
procedures.description: Empty trash cans, wipe benches, check restroom supplies, sweep breezeway.

procedures.title: Common Area Deep Clean
procedures.description: Mop breezeway, clean restroom fixtures, wipe all glass doors, detail benches and planters.

procedures.title: Directory and Wayfinding Update
procedures.description: Update tenant directory board with current tenants. Remove departed tenants. Add new tenants. Verify suite numbers match.

procedures.title: Dumpster Enclosure & Waste Management
procedures.description: Inspect dumpster enclosure gates, verify no overflow, check for illegal dumping, confirm grease trap area is clean.

procedures.title: Food Tenant Dumpster and Grease Bin Management
procedures.description: Inspect dumpster area for overflow, grease spills, odor. Verify grease recycling bin not overflowing. Schedule extra pickup if needed.

procedures.title: Electrical Emergency Response
procedures.description: Identify affected circuits, check main panels, call A&P Electrical (337-856-8383), notify affected tenants, document outage duration.

procedures.title: Electrical Panel Inspection
procedures.description: Open each electrical panel. Check for tripped breakers, signs of heat damage, loose wiring, or corrosion. Verify panel schedules are current and legible.

procedures.title: Elevator/Lift Certification
procedures.description: Schedule annual elevator inspection with state-certified inspector. Post current certificate in cab. Address any deficiencies within 30 days.

procedures.title: Emergency Mass Notification
procedures.description: Send urgent notification to all tenants via text, email, and posted notice. Include nature of emergency, actions required, timeline.

procedures.title: Emergency Plumbing Response
procedures.description: Locate shutoff valve, contain water, call emergency plumber, notify affected tenants, document damage, file insurance claim if needed.

procedures.title: Fire Extinguisher Inspection
procedures.description: Verify all fire extinguishers are charged, accessible, and have current inspection tags.

procedures.title: Fire Lane Compliance Check
procedures.description: Walk all fire lanes. Verify no vehicles parked, no obstructions, paint visible, signs posted. Issue warnings to violators.

procedures.title: Fire Marshal Inspection Prep
procedures.description: Prepare for annual fire marshal inspection. Verify all fire extinguishers current, exit signs lit, sprinkler access clear, electrical panels accessible, no blocked exits.

procedures.title: Food Tenant Pest Control Coordination
procedures.description: Coordinate pest control for food tenants and adjacent units. Verify monthly service reports. Address infestations within 24 hours.

procedures.title: Hard Freeze Preparation
procedures.description: When temps below 28F forecast: drip all exposed faucets, open cabinet doors, insulate exposed pipes, disconnect hoses, set HVAC to minimum 55F in vacant units.

procedures.title: Gas Line Leak Detection
procedures.description: Walk gas meter area. Check for rotten egg smell. Use leak detection solution on visible fittings. Report any leaks immediately.

procedures.title: Grease Trap Pumping Verification
procedures.description: Verify food tenants have grease trap pumped per lease requirements (quarterly). Collect pump receipts. Issue violation notice if overdue.

procedures.title: Handicap Parking Enforcement
procedures.description: Check all handicap spaces for proper signage, clear access aisles, no unauthorized vehicles. Report violations to Lafayette PD.

procedures.title: Health Department Inspection Prep
procedures.description: Before health inspections: verify dumpster cleanliness, no standing water near food tenants, pest control current, exterior grease containment clean.

procedures.title: Holiday Decoration Installation
procedures.description: Install seasonal decorations per approved plan. Check all electrical connections, verify timer settings, ensure ADA path clearance. Remove by January 15.

procedures.title: Hood and Ansul System Inspection
procedures.description: Verify all food tenants have current hood cleaning certificate and Ansul fire suppression inspection. Collect certificates.

procedures.title: Hurricane Preparation Procedure
procedures.description: Secure loose items, board windows if Cat 3+, notify tenants, verify insurance, backup systems.

procedures.title: Hurricane Preparation Checklist
procedures.description: When storm enters Gulf: secure loose items, board vacant units, sandbag low areas, photograph all exteriors, verify insurance docs, send tenant prep notice, fill generator.

procedures.title: Post-Hurricane Damage Assessment
procedures.description: After all-clear: photograph all damage, check roof, verify structural integrity, check utilities, clear parking lot, notify insurance, contact tenants.

procedures.title: HVAC Filter Inspection and Replacement
procedures.description: Inspect all rooftop HVAC units. Replace filters as needed. Log unit condition.

procedures.title: HVAC Preventive Maintenance Service (Butcher AC)
procedures.description: Coordinate with Butcher Air Conditioning for quarterly PM on all rooftop units. Verify completion report, log any repair recommendations.

procedures.title: Incident Report and Documentation
procedures.description: For any injury or property damage: photograph scene, collect witness info, complete incident report, notify insurance within 24 hours.

procedures.title: Tenant Insurance Certificate Audit
procedures.description: Pull all tenant COI expiration dates. Send 30-day renewal notices. Flag any lapsed policies. Update compliance tracker.

procedures.title: Vendor Invoice Processing
procedures.description: Receive invoice, verify work completion, match to PO/contract, approve for payment.

procedures.title: Irrigation System Inspection
procedures.description: Run each zone manually. Check for broken heads, misaligned spray, dry spots, and leaks. Adjust timer for season. Replace damaged heads.

procedures.title: Key and Access Audit
procedures.description: Reconcile master key log with issued keys. Verify all tenant keys match current occupancy. Re-key any units with unaccounted keys. Update lockbox codes.

procedures.title: Landscaping & Grounds Inspection
procedures.description: Inspect all landscaped areas, irrigation heads, tree limbs, flower beds. Note any dead plants, overgrowth, or irrigation leaks for vendor.

procedures.title: Annual Lease Renewal Pipeline Review
procedures.description: Review all leases expiring in next 12 months. Determine renewal strategy for each. Set market rate comps. Begin outreach 180 days out.

procedures.title: Lease Violation Notice Process
procedures.description: Document violation with photos, identify lease clause, draft cure notice, deliver per lease requirements (certified mail + hand delivery), set cure deadline, follow up.

procedures.title: Parking Lot Lighting Audit
procedures.description: Walk entire lot after dark. Map all light fixtures. Note any burned out, flickering, or dim fixtures. Measure foot-candles at key points. Schedule replacements.

procedures.title: Evening Lock-Up Procedure
procedures.description: Secure all common areas, verify tenant spaces are locked, arm security system.

procedures.title: Parking Lot Restriping
procedures.description: Schedule full lot restriping every 2-3 years. Get 3 quotes. Schedule overnight work. Notify tenants 72 hours ahead. Verify ADA compliance after.

procedures.title: Monthly Tenant Newsletter
procedures.description: Draft and send monthly newsletter covering upcoming maintenance, center events, new tenants, policy reminders, seasonal tips.

procedures.title: Monthly Owner Report
procedures.description: Compile income/expense summary, occupancy status, maintenance log, delinquency report, and upcoming lease events. Send to owner by the 10th.

procedures.title: Morning Opening Walkthrough
procedures.description: Inspect parking lot, check for overnight damage, verify signage, unlock common areas.

procedures.title: New Tenant Move-In Checklist
procedures.description: Complete all steps for tenant move-in: keys, signage, utility transfers, welcome packet.

procedures.title: Tenant Move-Out Procedure
procedures.description: Final walkthrough, document condition, return deposit calculation, key collection, utility transfer, signage removal, unit prep for next tenant.

procedures.title: Lawn Mowing and Edging
procedures.description: Mow all grass areas, edge sidewalks and curbs, blow clippings from walkways and parking areas. Trim around signs and light poles.

procedures.title: Mulch and Bed Refresh
procedures.description: Remove weeds from all landscape beds. Add fresh mulch to 3-inch depth. Replace dead plants. Trim hedges to uniform height. Edge bed borders.

procedures.title: Tenant Occupational License Verification
procedures.description: Verify each tenant has current City of Lafayette occupational license on file. Send reminder notices 60 days before expiration.

procedures.title: Parking Lot Restriping
procedures.description: Inspect all striping, handicap markings, fire lanes, directional arrows. Get bids from 2 vendors. Schedule for lowest-traffic period.

procedures.title: Parking Lot Sweep & Safety Check
procedures.description: Walk or drive the entire parking field. Remove debris, check for potholes, verify handicap signage, note any vehicle issues.

procedures.title: Pest Control Verification
procedures.description: Verify pest control vendor completed monthly service. Check bait stations, inspect dumpster area, and note any tenant pest complaints.

procedures.title: Pothole and Asphalt Repair
procedures.description: Identify potholes or cracking. Mark with spray paint. Get 2 quotes. Schedule during low-traffic hours. Inspect after completion.

procedures.title: Pressure Wash Sidewalks and Common Areas
procedures.description: Pressure wash all sidewalks, storefront aprons, and drive lanes. Schedule around business hours.

procedures.title: Sidewalk and Curb Pressure Washing
procedures.description: Pressure wash all common-area sidewalks, curbs, and dumpster pads. Remove gum, stains, and mildew. Start early morning before tenant hours.

procedures.title: Pylon Sign Maintenance
procedures.description: Inspect pylon sign structure, check all tenant panels for fading or damage, verify illumination, clean panels, check timer settings.

procedures.title: Lease Renewal Process
procedures.description: 90-day advance notice, market rate analysis, renewal letter, negotiate terms.

procedures.title: Rent Collection & Delinquency Follow-Up
procedures.description: Verify all rents received by the 5th. Send late notices on the 6th. Call delinquent tenants by the 10th. Escalate to demand letter by the 15th.

procedures.title: Rent Increase Notice Process
procedures.description: Draft notice per lease terms. Include effective date, new amount, breakdown of base + NNN. Send certified mail + email.

procedures.title: Roof Leak Emergency Response
procedures.description: Place containment, identify leak source from inside, access roof if safe, call roofer, notify tenant, document damage with photos/video.

procedures.title: Annual Professional Roof Inspection
procedures.description: Schedule professional roofer for full membrane inspection. Get written report with photos. Budget any recommended repairs.

procedures.title: Roof Visual Inspection
procedures.description: Access roof via Unit 135B ladder. Walk membrane, check around RTUs for ponding, tears, or flashing separation. Photograph any issues.

procedures.title: Safety & ADA Compliance Walk
procedures.description: Inspect all ADA ramps, handrails, trip hazards, parking lot condition, and emergency exit paths. Document deficiencies with photos.

procedures.title: Sewer Line Camera and Cleanout
procedures.description: Schedule plumber to camera main sewer lines. Identify root intrusion, grease buildup, or damage. Jet-clean as needed.

procedures.title: Unauthorized Sign Removal
procedures.description: Identify unauthorized signs. Issue notice to tenant. Remove if not corrected in 48 hours.

procedures.title: Signage & Lighting Inspection
procedures.description: Walk all tenant signs, pylon sign, directional signs, and parking lot lights. Note any burned-out bulbs, damaged panels, or non-compliant signs.

procedures.title: Slip and Fall Response Protocol
procedures.description: Assist injured party. Call 911 if needed. Photograph location and conditions. Identify witnesses. Do NOT admit fault. Notify insurance same day.

procedures.title: Spring Deep Clean and Refresh
procedures.description: Annual spring refresh: pressure wash all surfaces, repaint curbs, refresh mulch, clean gutters, service HVAC, deep clean common areas, touch up paint.

procedures.title: Parking Lot Striping and Signage Check
procedures.description: Inspect parking lot striping, handicap markings, and directional signage. Schedule restriping if faded.

procedures.title: Property Tax Assessment Review
procedures.description: Review annual tax assessment. Compare to market value. Determine if protest is warranted. File protest by deadline if applicable.

procedures.title: Telecom and Internet Infrastructure Audit
procedures.description: Inspect telecom closet, verify all patch panels labeled, check for unauthorized equipment, confirm fiber/cable runs documented.

procedures.title: Tenant Complaint Resolution
procedures.description: Log complaint, acknowledge within 2 hours, investigate, determine responsibility (landlord vs tenant), resolve or escalate, follow up within 48 hours.

procedures.title: New Tenant Sign Installation Approval
procedures.description: Review sign application against lease sign criteria. Verify city permit obtained. Schedule installer. Inspect after install.

procedures.title: Tenant Storefront Walk-By
procedures.description: Walk every storefront. Check for lease violations (unapproved signage, merchandise outside, window condition). Document with photos.

procedures.title: New Tenant Welcome Packet
procedures.description: Prepare welcome packet: property rules, emergency contacts, vendor list, trash schedule, HVAC requirements, sign criteria, insurance requirements, parking map.

procedures.title: Unauthorized Vehicle Towing
procedures.description: Identify unauthorized vehicles. Photograph, place warning sticker, wait 24 hours, then call tow company. Document everything.

procedures.title: Tree Trimming and Canopy Management
procedures.description: Inspect all trees for dead limbs, overgrowth blocking signs or lights, root damage to sidewalks. Schedule arborist for major work. Clear limbs from roof.

procedures.title: Trespass Warning Issuance
procedures.description: Identify trespasser, issue verbal then written warning, document with photos, file with Lafayette PD if repeat offender, notify tenants of known trespassers.

procedures.title: Vendor COI Verification
procedures.description: Before any vendor starts work: verify current COI with adequate limits, workers comp, auto liability. Belle Realty listed as additional insured.

procedures.title: New Vendor Onboarding
procedures.description: Collect W-9, verify insurance, execute vendor agreement, set up in payment system, provide property access instructions and emergency contacts.

procedures.title: Annual Vendor Performance Review
procedures.description: Evaluate all recurring vendors on quality, responsiveness, pricing, and reliability.

procedures.title: Quarterly Vendor Scorecard
procedures.description: Rate each active vendor on response time, quality, pricing, and communication. Document issues. Identify any vendors to replace.

procedures.title: Water Shutoff Valve Test
procedures.description: Locate and exercise all water shutoff valves. Verify they turn freely and seal properly. Label any unlabeled valves.

steps.title: Check handicap parking
steps.instructions: Count spaces (1 per 25 required). Verify proper signage height (60 inches to bottom). Check van-accessible spaces have 8-foot aisle.
steps.warning_note: ADA violations carry heavy fines — take seriously

steps.title: Inspect ramps and curb cuts
steps.instructions: Check all ramps: maximum 1:12 slope, handrails on both sides if over 6 inches rise, non-slip surface, no obstructions.

steps.title: Measure door widths
steps.instructions: All public doors must provide 32-inch clear opening. Check door hardware operable with one hand. Verify door closers allow 5 seconds.

steps.title: Check restroom compliance
steps.instructions: Verify grab bars secure, toilet height 17-19 inches, clear floor space, accessible sink, mirror at 40 inches max, door swings out.

steps.title: Document and prioritize
steps.instructions: Photograph all deficiencies. Prioritize by immediate safety hazard, high-traffic areas, complaint-driven. Get quotes. Create timeline.

steps.title: Compile actual expenses
steps.instructions: Pull all expenses for the year by category: CAM, tax, insurance, repairs, capital, admin. Compare to budget.

steps.title: Calculate per-tenant reconciliation
steps.instructions: For each tenant, calculate: estimated NNN paid vs actual pro-rata share. Determine over/under payment.

steps.title: Draft reconciliation letters
steps.instructions: Prepare individual reconciliation letters showing calculation. Include supporting documentation for any increases.
steps.warning_note: Must be sent within 120 days of year-end per most leases

steps.title: Set next year estimates
steps.instructions: Project next years CAM, tax, and insurance based on trends, known increases, and planned capital work.

steps.title: Review with owner
steps.instructions: Present budget to owner. Discuss: expected income, planned capital expenditures, reserve contributions, and any rent adjustments.

steps.title: Send tenant notices
steps.instructions: Send NNN estimate adjustment letters to all tenants. Must provide 30-day notice before new rates take effect.

steps.title: Update billing system
steps.instructions: Update DoorLoop with new monthly NNN amounts for each tenant effective January 1.

steps.title: Categorize monthly expenses
steps.instructions: Review all invoices paid this month. Categorize each as: CAM (maintenance, landscaping, cleaning), Tax, or Insurance.

steps.title: Update running totals
steps.instructions: Add this months expenses to the YTD tracking spreadsheet. Compare to budget projections.

steps.title: Flag variances
steps.instructions: If any category is trending 15%+ over budget, flag for owner review. Identify cause and recommend adjustment.

steps.title: File receipts
steps.instructions: Scan and file all receipts/invoices in the property drive under the correct month folder.

steps.title: Log into DVR/NVR system
steps.instructions: Access the recording system. Verify system is recording. Check storage — should have minimum 30 days retention. Note any error messages.

steps.title: Check each camera feed
steps.instructions: View each camera live. Verify image is clear, properly aimed, and recording. Note any cameras showing black screen, static, or wrong angle.

steps.title: Test night vision
steps.instructions: After dark, verify infrared/night vision is activating on all exterior cameras. Image should be clear enough to identify faces at 20 feet.

steps.title: Clean camera lenses
steps.instructions: Use microfiber cloth to clean all accessible camera lenses. Remove spider webs, dirt, and water spots.

steps.title: Test remote access
steps.instructions: Verify you can access camera feeds from mobile app and remote desktop. Test both live view and playback.

steps.title: Pull expiration report
steps.instructions: Generate list of all tenant COIs expiring in next 60 days from DoorLoop or tracking spreadsheet.

steps.title: Send 30-day reminder
steps.instructions: Email tenants whose COI expires within 30 days. Include expiration date, required coverage amounts, requirement to list Belle Realty as additional insured.

steps.title: Verify received COIs
steps.instructions: For each renewed COI: verify policy dates, coverage amounts ($1M/$2M minimum), Belle Realty of Lafayette LLC listed as additional insured, property address correct.
steps.warning_note: Do not accept COIs without additional insured endorsement

steps.title: Issue non-compliance notice
steps.instructions: For tenants 15+ days past expiration without renewal: send formal lease violation notice. Note that operating without insurance is a material lease default.

steps.title: Update records
steps.instructions: File new COIs. Update expiration tracking. Set calendar reminders for next cycle.

steps.title: Log complaint
steps.instructions: Record: tenant name/unit, date/time, nature of complaint, and how it was received (phone, email, in-person, app).

steps.title: Acknowledge within 2 hours
steps.instructions: Respond to tenant confirming receipt of complaint. Provide expected timeline for investigation/resolution.

steps.title: Investigate
steps.instructions: Visit the site. Verify the issue. Determine: is this a landlord responsibility, tenant responsibility, or neighbor dispute?

steps.title: Determine resolution
steps.instructions: Based on investigation: schedule repair, issue notice to offending party, mediate between tenants, or explain why no action is warranted.

steps.title: Resolve or escalate
steps.instructions: If straightforward: fix it. If complex or requires owner decision: brief owner with facts and recommendation.

steps.title: Follow up within 48 hours
steps.instructions: Contact tenant to confirm resolution is satisfactory. If not resolved yet, provide updated timeline. Document outcome.

steps.title: Mop breezeway floor
steps.instructions: Wet mop entire breezeway with commercial cleaner. Pay attention to corners and edges. Allow to dry before foot traffic.
steps.warning_note: Place wet floor signs during mopping

steps.title: Clean all glass doors
steps.instructions: Clean both sides of all common area glass doors with glass cleaner. Check for scratches or seal damage.

steps.title: Deep clean restrooms
steps.instructions: Scrub toilets, sinks, and floors. Disinfect all surfaces. Check caulking and grout. Restock all supplies. Check for leaks under sinks.

steps.title: Detail benches and planters
steps.instructions: Scrub benches with appropriate cleaner. Remove gum or stains. Clean planter edges. Remove weeds from planter beds.

steps.title: Clean light fixtures
steps.instructions: Wipe down accessible light fixture covers. Remove bugs and debris. Note any fixtures needing bulb replacement.

steps.title: Inspect and report
steps.instructions: Document condition of all common areas. Note any repairs needed (cracked tile, peeling paint, damaged fixtures). Submit work orders.

steps.title: Inspect enclosure gates
steps.instructions: Verify both gates open/close properly. Check hinges, latches, and lock. Gates must be closed when not in use per city ordinance.

steps.title: Check for overflow
steps.instructions: If dumpster is more than 80% full, call waste vendor for extra pickup. Do not allow overflow — attracts pests and violates code.
steps.warning_note: Overflow = code violation + pest risk

steps.title: Check for illegal dumping
steps.instructions: Look for furniture, appliances, construction debris, or items from non-tenants. Photograph and report. Check security camera footage if available.

steps.title: Inspect grease trap area
steps.instructions: Check grease trap for overflow or odor. Verify food tenants (107, 113, 149) are using grease trap properly. Schedule pumping if needed.
steps.warning_note: Grease trap overflow = environmental violation — urgent

steps.title: Clean surrounding area
steps.instructions: Sweep around dumpster enclosure. Remove any loose trash or cardboard that blew out. Hose down if grease or food residue present.

steps.title: Assess scope
steps.instructions: Determine if outage is: single unit, multiple units, entire property, or neighborhood-wide. Check LUS outage map.

steps.title: Check breaker panels
steps.instructions: If property-specific, check main panels (located at rear of each building section). Look for tripped breakers. Do NOT reset if burning smell or visible damage.
steps.warning_note: Do NOT touch panels if water present or burning smell detected — call electrician immediately

steps.title: Call electrician
steps.instructions: Call A&P Electrical Service (337-856-8383). Describe symptoms: which units affected, any sounds/smells, and panel condition.

steps.title: Notify affected tenants
steps.instructions: Alert tenants of the issue and estimated repair time. Advise them to unplug sensitive equipment to prevent surge damage on restoration.

steps.title: Document and follow up
steps.instructions: Record: time of outage, cause (if known), duration, affected units, and repair performed. Update maintenance log.

steps.title: Access all panels safely
steps.instructions: Wear rubber-soled shoes. Use insulated tools only. Open each panel cover carefully. Never touch bus bars or live connections.
steps.warning_note: Electrical work is dangerous — if unsure, call electrician

steps.title: Visual inspection
steps.instructions: Look for discolored/melted wires, burn marks, corrosion, loose connections, signs of water intrusion, pest damage, missing knockouts.

steps.title: Check breaker status
steps.instructions: Note any tripped breakers. Reset if appropriate. If breaker trips again immediately, do not reset — call electrician.

steps.title: Verify panel schedules
steps.instructions: Check that panel directory is legible and accurate. Each breaker should be labeled with what it controls. Update labels if incorrect.

steps.title: Check GFCI outlets
steps.instructions: Test all GFCI outlets in common areas and exterior locations. Press test button, verify power cuts, press reset. Replace any that fail.

steps.title: Locate all extinguishers
steps.instructions: Verify all 14 extinguisher locations match the site map. Report any missing units immediately.

steps.title: Check pressure gauge
steps.instructions: Gauge needle must be in the green zone. If in red, unit needs recharge or replacement.

steps.title: Inspect physical condition
steps.instructions: Check for dents, rust, cracked hose, missing pin, or broken tamper seal.

steps.title: Verify inspection tag
steps.instructions: Current year tag must be attached. If expired, schedule professional inspection.
steps.warning_note: Annual professional inspection required by fire code

steps.title: Test accessibility
steps.instructions: Confirm nothing is blocking access. Extinguisher must be within 75 feet of any point in the building.

steps.title: Initial and date tag
steps.instructions: Sign and date the monthly inspection tag. Photograph for compliance records.

steps.title: Check all fire extinguishers
steps.instructions: Walk every unit and common area. Verify each extinguisher has current annual inspection tag, pressure gauge in green zone, pin intact, no physical damage.
steps.warning_note: Expired extinguishers must be replaced before inspection

steps.title: Verify exit signs and emergency lighting
steps.instructions: Test all exit signs (illuminated and battery backup). Press test button on emergency lights — must stay lit 90 seconds minimum.

steps.title: Clear electrical panel access
steps.instructions: Ensure 36-inch clearance in front of all electrical panels. Remove any stored items. Verify panel covers are on and labeled.

steps.title: Check fire lanes and exits
steps.instructions: Walk all fire lanes — no vehicles, no obstructions, paint visible. All exit doors must open freely without keys from inside.
steps.warning_note: Blocked exits are immediate violations

steps.title: Verify sprinkler clearance
steps.instructions: Check 18-inch clearance below all sprinkler heads. No storage, shelving, or decorations within clearance zone.

steps.title: Document and schedule corrections
steps.instructions: Photograph any deficiencies found. Create work orders for corrections. Schedule corrections before inspection date.

steps.title: Monitor forecast
steps.instructions: When temps below 28F forecast for 4+ hours: activate freeze protocol 24 hours before expected freeze.

steps.title: Insulate exposed pipes
steps.instructions: Wrap all exposed water pipes with foam insulation. Focus on exterior hose bibs, pipes in unheated spaces, irrigation backflow preventers.

steps.title: Drip faucets in vacant units
steps.instructions: Open faucets to a slow drip in all vacant units — both hot and cold lines. This prevents pressure buildup from freezing.
steps.warning_note: Frozen pipes in vacant units cause major damage

steps.title: Set HVAC minimums
steps.instructions: Set thermostats in all vacant units to minimum 55F. Verify HVAC units are running. Check that no units are set to off or cool only.

steps.title: Disconnect hoses and shut irrigation
steps.instructions: Disconnect all garden hoses. Shut off irrigation system. Drain irrigation lines if extended freeze expected.

steps.title: Notify tenants
steps.instructions: Send freeze advisory to all tenants: drip faucets, open cabinet doors under sinks, report pipe issues immediately, keep heat on overnight.

steps.title: Check pump schedule
steps.instructions: Review lease requirements for each food tenant grease trap pumping frequency. Typically every 90 days. Check last pump date in records.

steps.title: Request pump receipts
steps.instructions: Contact each food tenant. Request copy of most recent pump receipt showing date, volume removed, and disposal manifest.

steps.title: Inspect trap condition
steps.instructions: Visually inspect grease trap access covers. Check for overflow, odor, or grease on ground surface around trap.
steps.warning_note: Overflowing trap is environmental violation — address immediately

steps.title: Issue violation if overdue
steps.instructions: If tenant is more than 7 days past due on pumping, issue written notice with 48-hour cure period. Schedule emergency pump at tenant expense if not cured.

steps.title: File receipts
steps.instructions: File all pump receipts in tenant compliance folder. Update tracking spreadsheet with dates. Set reminder for next due date.

steps.title: Monitor storm (72 hours out)
steps.instructions: Track storm path via NWS. If Lafayette is in cone of uncertainty, begin preparations. Notify owner and all tenants.

steps.title: Secure loose items (48 hours)
steps.instructions: Remove or secure: outdoor furniture, planters, trash cans, signage, and any loose materials. Store inside if possible.

steps.title: Board windows if Cat 3+
steps.instructions: If Category 3 or higher projected, install plywood on all storefront windows. Pre-cut boards stored in Unit 135B utility room.
steps.warning_note: Only board for Cat 3+ — boarding for Cat 1-2 causes more damage from trapped moisture

steps.title: Notify all tenants
steps.instructions: Send formal notification: recommended closure timeline, insurance reminder, secure their inventory, and emergency contacts.

steps.title: Verify insurance
steps.instructions: Confirm property insurance is current. Review deductible and coverage limits. Document pre-storm condition with photos/video.

steps.title: Backup systems
steps.instructions: Download all digital records. Ensure cloud backups are current. Print emergency contact list. Charge all devices.

steps.title: Shut down utilities
steps.instructions: If evacuation ordered: shut off water main, secure electrical panels, turn off HVAC systems. Do NOT shut off gas (utility company handles).
steps.warning_note: Do NOT shut off natural gas yourself — call LUS

steps.title: Post-storm inspection
steps.instructions: After storm passes, inspect property BEFORE allowing tenants to return. Check: roof, structural, electrical, water intrusion, trees/debris.
steps.warning_note: Do not enter if structural damage suspected — call engineer

steps.title: Document damage
steps.instructions: Photograph and video ALL damage before any cleanup. This is critical for insurance claims. Note date/time on all documentation.

steps.title: File insurance claim
steps.instructions: Contact insurance carrier within 24 hours of storm. Provide initial damage report. Schedule adjuster visit. Begin emergency repairs only.

steps.title: Monitor storm and activate plan
steps.instructions: When tropical system enters Gulf with OTB in cone: activate hurricane plan. Begin 72-hour countdown checklist.

steps.title: Secure loose exterior items
steps.instructions: Remove or secure all A-frame signs, planters, trash cans, patio furniture, and loose items that could become projectiles.

steps.title: Board vacant units
steps.instructions: Install plywood over windows of all vacant units. Secure doors. Verify no water entry points.

steps.title: Photograph all exteriors
steps.instructions: Take timestamped photos of every building face, roof, parking lot, and sign. This is your pre-storm baseline for insurance claims.
steps.warning_note: Critical for insurance — do not skip

steps.title: Sandbag vulnerable areas
steps.instructions: Place sandbags at any known water intrusion points, low doorways, and drainage problem areas.

steps.title: Send tenant notification
steps.instructions: Email and text all tenants: storm timeline, recommended actions, property closure plan, emergency contacts, post-storm communication plan.

steps.title: Verify insurance and contacts
steps.instructions: Confirm insurance policy numbers accessible offline. Save adjuster contact info. Download property inventory to phone.

steps.title: Fill generator and prep utilities
steps.instructions: Fill generator fuel tank. Test generator. Locate all utility shutoffs. Consider preemptive gas shutoff if Cat 3+.
steps.warning_note: Only shut off gas for Cat 3+ storms

steps.title: Access rooftop units
steps.instructions: Use roof ladder at Unit 135B. Bring replacement filters (sizes listed on each unit). Safety harness required.

steps.title: Inspect each unit filter
steps.instructions: Remove filter, check for excessive dirt/damage. Photograph condition before replacement.
steps.warning_note: Turn off unit before opening filter compartment

steps.title: Replace if needed
steps.instructions: Install new filter with airflow arrow pointing toward blower. Record filter size and unit number.

steps.title: Check condensate drain
steps.instructions: Verify drain line is clear. Pour small amount of water to test flow. Clear any algae buildup.

steps.title: Log unit condition
steps.instructions: Note any unusual sounds, rust, refrigerant smell, or visible damage. Flag for HVAC tech if needed.

steps.title: Update maintenance log
steps.instructions: Record date, units serviced, filters replaced, and any issues flagged in the system.

steps.title: Schedule with Butcher AC
steps.instructions: Call Butcher Air Conditioning to schedule quarterly PM. Confirm date and time. Provide roof access instructions.

steps.title: Notify affected tenants
steps.instructions: Email tenants that HVAC service is scheduled. Units may be off for 15-30 minutes during service. Schedule during mild weather if possible.

steps.title: Provide roof access
steps.instructions: Meet vendor on-site. Provide ladder/roof access. Ensure they have the unit map showing which RTU serves which tenant.

steps.title: Review completion report
steps.instructions: Get written report from vendor listing: each unit serviced, refrigerant levels, filter condition, any repairs recommended.

steps.title: Determine repair responsibility
steps.instructions: For any recommended repairs, check HVAC responsibility matrix. Determine if landlord or tenant responsibility per lease terms.
steps.warning_note: Reference HVAC tier data in property data — repair/replace thresholds vary by unit

steps.title: Schedule repairs and update records
steps.instructions: Schedule any needed repairs. Update HVAC maintenance log. File vendor report in property records.

steps.title: Secure the scene
steps.instructions: Ensure safety of all persons. Call 911 if medical attention needed. Rope off area if hazard exists. Do not disturb evidence.
steps.warning_note: Life safety first — always

steps.title: Photograph everything
steps.instructions: Take photos from multiple angles: wide shot of area, close-up of hazard/damage, any contributing conditions. Include timestamps.

steps.title: Collect witness information
steps.instructions: Get names, phone numbers, and brief statements from any witnesses. Ask what they saw, heard, and when. Do not coach answers.

steps.title: Complete incident report form
steps.instructions: Fill out: date/time, exact location, persons involved, description of incident, weather/conditions, actions taken, witnesses. Be factual only.
steps.warning_note: NEVER admit fault or liability in any documentation

steps.title: Notify insurance carrier
steps.instructions: Report to insurance carrier within 24 hours. Provide incident report, photos, and witness info. Get claim number.

steps.title: Correct the hazard
steps.instructions: Fix the condition that caused the incident. Document the repair with before/after photos.

steps.title: Pull all COI expiration dates
steps.instructions: Export current COI records from compliance tracker. List each tenant, policy number, and expiration date.

steps.title: Identify expiring policies
steps.instructions: Flag any COIs expiring in the next 90 days. These tenants need renewal reminders.

steps.title: Send renewal notices
steps.instructions: Email tenants with expiring COIs. Request updated certificate naming Belle Realty of Lafayette, LLC as additional insured. Set 30-day deadline.

steps.title: Follow up on lapsed policies
steps.instructions: For any currently lapsed COIs, send formal notice citing lease requirement. Give 10-day cure period.
steps.warning_note: Lapsed insurance = lease default — document carefully

steps.title: Verify coverage amounts
steps.instructions: Confirm each COI meets minimum requirements: $1M general liability, $2M aggregate, property damage per lease.

steps.title: Update compliance tracker
steps.instructions: Mark all verified COIs as ok in the compliance system. Flag any outstanding as flag with notes.

steps.title: Receive and log invoice
steps.instructions: Enter invoice in tracking system: vendor name, date, amount, description of work, and which property area.

steps.title: Verify work completion
steps.instructions: Confirm the work was actually completed satisfactorily. Check against work order or contract scope. Get on-site verification if needed.

steps.title: Match to contract/PO
steps.instructions: Verify invoice amount matches contract rate or approved estimate. Flag any overages for review before payment.

steps.title: Categorize expense
steps.instructions: Code to correct category: CAM, repair, capital improvement, insurance claim, or tenant-billable. This affects NNN reconciliation.

steps.title: Approve and schedule payment
steps.instructions: Approve for payment. Schedule per vendor terms (Net 15, Net 30). Process through accounting system.

steps.title: File documentation
steps.instructions: Scan invoice and any supporting photos/reports. File in property drive under vendor folder and month.

steps.title: Run each zone manually
steps.instructions: At controller, run each zone for 2 minutes. Walk the zone while running. Note any heads not popping up or spraying wrong direction.

steps.title: Check for leaks and breaks
steps.instructions: Look for geysers (broken head), pooling water (underground leak), dry spots (clogged nozzle), overspray onto buildings or parking lot.

steps.title: Adjust heads and nozzles
steps.instructions: Realign any misdirected heads. Clear clogged nozzles. Adjust arc and radius to avoid watering pavement. Replace broken heads.

steps.title: Update timer schedule
steps.instructions: Adjust run times for current season. Summer: 3x/week early morning. Winter: 1x/week. Verify rain sensor working.

steps.title: Document and report
steps.instructions: Note any repairs needed beyond basic adjustment. Get quotes for major repairs. Update irrigation map if heads were added or moved.

steps.title: Inspect front landscaping (Arnould side)
steps.instructions: Walk the Arnould Blvd frontage. Check shrubs, mulch beds, and entrance plantings. Note any dead or overgrown plants.

steps.title: Check irrigation system
steps.instructions: Run each zone for 2 minutes. Look for broken heads, misaligned spray, or dry spots. Note any leaks or pooling water.
steps.warning_note: Do not run irrigation during business hours — early morning only

steps.title: Inspect tree canopy
steps.instructions: Check all trees for dead limbs, low-hanging branches (must be 8ft+ clearance over walkways), or root damage to sidewalks.

steps.title: Check Patricia St side
steps.instructions: Walk the Patricia St boundary. Verify fence line is clear, no overgrowth from neighboring property, drainage swale is clear.

steps.title: Inspect Johnston St corner
steps.instructions: Check pylon sign landscaping, corner visibility triangle (no plantings above 30 inches), and monument sign bed.

steps.title: Document and notify vendor
steps.instructions: Photograph any issues. Email landscaping vendor with work order if action needed. Set follow-up date.

steps.title: Place containment
steps.instructions: Put buckets or tarps under active leak. Protect tenant inventory and flooring. Move any electronics away from water.

steps.title: Identify source from inside
steps.instructions: Look at ceiling for water trail direction. Water often travels along rafters before dripping — source may not be directly above the drip.

steps.title: Access roof if safe
steps.instructions: If rain has stopped and roof is safe to access, go up and look for obvious damage: torn membrane, displaced flashing, clogged drain causing ponding.
steps.warning_note: Do NOT access roof during active rain or lightning

steps.title: Emergency patch if possible
steps.instructions: If small tear or gap visible, apply roof sealant or emergency patch tape as temporary fix. This is NOT a permanent repair.

steps.title: Call roofer
steps.instructions: Contact roofing contractor for permanent repair. Provide: location, photos, and description of damage. Request next-day service.

steps.title: Notify tenant and document
steps.instructions: Inform tenant of repair timeline. Photograph all damage (ceiling, walls, floor, inventory). File insurance claim if damage is significant.

steps.title: Walk the parking lot
steps.instructions: Check for abandoned vehicles, debris, or safety hazards. Note any issues for morning follow-up.

steps.title: Verify all tenant spaces are closed
steps.instructions: Walk the storefront corridor. Confirm each tenant has closed and locked their door. Note any open units.

steps.title: Lock common area restrooms
steps.instructions: Lock both restroom doors. Verify no one is inside before locking.

steps.title: Check dumpster enclosure
steps.instructions: Ensure dumpster gates are closed and latched. Report overflow to waste vendor.

steps.title: Arm security system
steps.instructions: Enter code at main panel (location: Unit 135B utility closet). Verify green armed indicator.

steps.title: Lock main breezeway gates
steps.instructions: Lock both east and west breezeway gates. Test each lock.

steps.title: Final perimeter check
steps.instructions: Drive perimeter once. Check exterior lighting is operational. Report any outages.

steps.title: Drive the perimeter
steps.instructions: Enter from Arnould Blvd. Drive slowly around the entire property perimeter. Check fencing, curbs, and exterior walls for overnight damage or graffiti.

steps.title: Inspect parking lot
steps.instructions: Look for potholes, debris, abandoned vehicles, or fluid spills. Check handicap spaces are clear and properly marked. Note any issues.

steps.title: Check overnight damage
steps.instructions: Walk the storefront corridor. Look for broken glass, forced entry signs, water damage, or vandalism. Photograph anything unusual.
steps.warning_note: If break-in suspected, do NOT enter — call 911 first

steps.title: Verify exterior lighting
steps.instructions: Confirm all parking lot lights turned off (photocell). Note any fixtures that stayed on (stuck relay) or appear damaged.

steps.title: Unlock common areas
steps.instructions: Unlock breezeway gates (east and west), restrooms, and any shared utility rooms. Disarm security system at Unit 135B panel.

steps.title: Check signage
steps.instructions: Verify pylon sign is illuminated (if before sunrise). Check that all tenant signs are intact and no panels are missing or damaged.

steps.title: Empty overnight trash
steps.instructions: Empty any overflowing exterior trash cans. Check dumpster area for overnight illegal dumping.

steps.title: Log and report
steps.instructions: Enter any issues found into the maintenance request system. Flag urgent items for immediate attention. Send morning status to owner if issues found.

steps.title: Verify lease execution
steps.instructions: Confirm fully executed lease is on file. Verify all deposits received. Check that all lease conditions precedent are met.
steps.warning_note: Do NOT hand over keys without executed lease + deposit

steps.title: Collect required documents
steps.instructions: Obtain: Certificate of Insurance (naming Belle Realty as additional insured), W-9, occupational license application, ACH authorization.

steps.title: Conduct move-in walkthrough
steps.instructions: Walk the unit with tenant. Document existing condition with photos/video. Both parties sign condition report. Note any pre-existing damage.

steps.title: Transfer utilities
steps.instructions: Provide tenant with LUS account setup instructions. Verify they have transferred electric to their name. Confirm meter number.

steps.title: Provide keys and access
steps.instructions: Issue keys: front door, rear door (if applicable), restroom, dumpster. Record all key numbers. Get signed key receipt.

steps.title: Signage coordination
steps.instructions: Review tenants proposed signage against sign criteria. Approve or request modifications. Coordinate installation timeline.

steps.title: Welcome packet
steps.instructions: Provide: emergency contacts, maintenance request process, operating hours, trash/recycling schedule, parking rules, neighbor introduction.

steps.title: Update systems
steps.instructions: Add tenant to: DoorLoop, communication list, pylon sign (if applicable), directory, and compliance tracker. Set up recurring billing.

steps.title: Confirm move-out date
steps.instructions: Verify lease expiration or early termination terms. Confirm tenants intended move-out date in writing.

steps.title: Send move-out requirements
steps.instructions: Email tenant the move-out checklist: remove all personal property, patch holes, clean unit, return to original condition per lease.

steps.title: Schedule final walkthrough
steps.instructions: Schedule walkthrough for move-out day or day after. Both parties should attend. Bring move-in condition report for comparison.

steps.title: Conduct walkthrough
steps.instructions: Document unit condition with photos/video. Compare to move-in report. Note any damage beyond normal wear and tear. Both parties sign.

steps.title: Collect keys
steps.instructions: Collect ALL keys issued. Check against key receipt from move-in. Re-key locks if any keys unaccounted for.

steps.title: Remove signage
steps.instructions: Remove tenant signage from storefront and pylon sign. Patch any holes. Install Available or Coming Soon signage.

steps.title: Calculate deposit return
steps.instructions: Itemize any deductions: damage repairs, cleaning, unpaid rent, signage removal. Return balance within 30 days per Louisiana law.
steps.warning_note: Louisiana law: deposit must be returned within 30 days with itemized deductions

steps.title: Transfer utilities back
steps.instructions: Transfer electric back to landlord name. Verify final meter reading. Check for any utility balance owed by tenant.

steps.title: Prep unit for market
steps.instructions: Clean unit, make repairs, paint if needed, verify HVAC working. Take marketing photos. List on available inventory.

steps.title: Update systems
steps.instructions: Remove tenant from: DoorLoop, communication list, pylon sign, directory, compliance tracker. Update vacancy records.

steps.title: Gather content
steps.instructions: Collect: upcoming maintenance schedules, new tenant announcements, center events, policy reminders, seasonal tips, construction updates.

steps.title: Draft newsletter
steps.instructions: Write in friendly, professional tone. Keep to 1 page equivalent. Include greeting, 2-3 main items, important dates, contact reminder.

steps.title: Review and send
steps.instructions: Proofread for accuracy. Verify all dates and names correct. Send via email to all tenant primary contacts. BCC management.

steps.title: Walk main parking field
steps.instructions: Start at the Arnould Blvd entrance. Walk all rows checking for trash, broken glass, nails, or trip hazards. Pick up debris as you go.

steps.title: Check handicap spaces
steps.instructions: Verify all 6 handicap spaces are properly signed, striped, and unobstructed. Check that access aisles are clear.
steps.warning_note: ADA violation if blocked — address immediately

steps.title: Inspect drive lanes
steps.instructions: Check for potholes, cracking, or standing water. Note any areas where striping is faded beyond readability.

steps.title: Check Lot 8 (rear)
steps.instructions: Walk the rear parking area behind the long building. Check for abandoned vehicles (48-hour rule), illegal parking, or dumping.

steps.title: Note vehicle issues
steps.instructions: Record any vehicles parked overnight without authorization, vehicles with flat tires (abandoned), or commercial vehicles in non-designated areas.

steps.title: Log findings
steps.instructions: Enter any maintenance needs into the system. If pothole or safety hazard found, place cone and schedule repair within 24 hours.

steps.title: Verify vendor service completed
steps.instructions: Check pest control service log. Vendor should have serviced this month. If not, call to schedule immediately.

steps.title: Check exterior bait stations
steps.instructions: Walk perimeter and verify all bait stations are intact, properly positioned, and not disturbed.

steps.title: Inspect dumpster area
steps.instructions: Check for rodent activity near dumpster (droppings, gnaw marks, burrows). Report to vendor if found.

steps.title: Review tenant complaints
steps.instructions: Check if any tenants reported pest issues this month. Coordinate with vendor for targeted treatment if needed.

steps.title: Pull expiration report
steps.instructions: List all leases expiring in the next 12 months. Include: unit, tenant, expiration date, current rate, and renewal option terms.

steps.title: Research market rates
steps.instructions: Pull comparable lease rates from LoopNet, CoStar, or local broker contacts. Current market: $10-17/SF/yr NNN for this submarket.

steps.title: Determine renewal strategy
steps.instructions: For each expiring lease, decide: renew at market, renew below market (strategic tenant), let expire, or non-renew.

steps.title: Begin outreach (180 days)
steps.instructions: Contact tenants 180 days before expiration. Gauge interest in renewal. Present proposed terms.

steps.title: Negotiate and document
steps.instructions: Negotiate renewal terms. Document all conversations. Get signed renewal or amendment 90 days before expiration.

steps.title: Plan for non-renewals
steps.instructions: For any tenant not renewing, begin marketing the space immediately. Start move-out planning 60 days out.

steps.title: Locate and close shutoff valve
steps.instructions: Main water shutoff is at the meter near Arnould Blvd entrance. Individual unit shutoffs are in the rear utility chase. Close the nearest valve to stop flow.
steps.warning_note: If you cannot locate shutoff, call LUS emergency: 337-291-8280

steps.title: Contain water
steps.instructions: Place buckets, towels, or barriers to prevent water from spreading to adjacent units. Move any inventory or equipment away from water.

steps.title: Call emergency plumber
steps.instructions: Call All Around Plumbing (337-988-1570) or Almost There Plumbing (337-896-3198). Describe issue and location. Request ETA.

steps.title: Notify affected tenants
steps.instructions: Alert any tenants whose units are affected or whose water will be shut off. Provide estimated timeline for repair.

steps.title: Document damage
steps.instructions: Photograph all water damage before and during cleanup. Note: source of leak, affected areas, tenant inventory damaged, and timeline.

steps.title: Determine responsibility
steps.instructions: Review lease: landlord responsible for main lines and common plumbing. Tenant responsible for fixtures and drain lines within their unit.

steps.title: File insurance if needed
steps.instructions: If damage exceeds $5,000, file property insurance claim. Provide photos, plumber report, and repair estimates.

steps.title: Schedule with tenants
steps.instructions: Notify all tenants 48 hours in advance. Schedule for early morning (before 8 AM) or after close. Avoid food tenant hours.

steps.title: Prep the area
steps.instructions: Move any outdoor furniture, planters, or merchandise. Cover electrical outlets and any sensitive equipment near wash zones.

steps.title: Wash sidewalks
steps.instructions: Pressure wash all sidewalks from building face outward. Pay attention to gum spots, grease stains, and high-traffic areas.

steps.title: Wash storefront aprons
steps.instructions: Clean the 4-foot apron in front of each unit. Remove any staining or discoloration.

steps.title: Wash drive lanes
steps.instructions: Clean drive lanes in front of the building, focusing on grease spots near food tenants (107, 113, 149).

steps.title: Wash dumpster pad
steps.instructions: Pressure wash the concrete pad around the dumpster enclosure. Use degreaser if needed.

steps.title: Final inspection
steps.instructions: Walk the entire washed area. Touch up any missed spots. Verify no damage to surfaces or tenant property. Replace moved items.

steps.title: Inspect structure
steps.instructions: Check pylon base for cracks, rust, or leaning. Inspect all mounting hardware. Look for loose panels or damaged frames.

steps.title: Check illumination
steps.instructions: After dark, verify all panels are evenly lit. Note any dark spots, flickering, or panels not illuminating. Check timer matches sunset/sunrise.

steps.title: Clean panels
steps.instructions: Use soft cloth and mild cleaner on all sign faces. Remove dirt, bird droppings, and insect buildup. Do not use abrasive cleaners on acrylic.

steps.title: Update tenant panels
steps.instructions: Verify all panels show current tenants. Remove departed tenant panels. Schedule new panels for incoming tenants. Keep blank panels clean.

steps.title: Document condition
steps.instructions: Photograph pylon from all sides. Note any needed repairs in maintenance log. Get quotes for structural or electrical issues.

steps.title: Identify renewal candidates
steps.instructions: Pull leases expiring in 6-9 months. Check for renewal option clauses. Note any tenants with known issues.

steps.title: Research market rates
steps.instructions: Pull current market comps for similar space in Lafayette. Current range: $10-17/SF/yr NNN depending on size and condition.

steps.title: Determine renewal terms
steps.instructions: Set proposed rate (at or above market), term length (3-5 years preferred), and any lease modifications needed.

steps.title: Send renewal letter
steps.instructions: Send formal renewal offer letter 180 days before expiration. Include: proposed rate, term, any changes to NNN estimates, and response deadline.

steps.title: Negotiate if needed
steps.instructions: If tenant counters, evaluate: tenant quality, market conditions, cost to re-tenant, and downtime risk. Get owner approval for any concessions.

steps.title: Execute renewal amendment
steps.instructions: Draft lease renewal amendment. Both parties sign. Update rent roll, billing system, and compliance tracker with new terms.

steps.title: Update COI requirements
steps.instructions: Request updated COI reflecting new lease term. Verify coverage amounts still meet requirements.

steps.title: Verify payments received (by 5th)
steps.instructions: Check DoorLoop/bank for all tenant payments. Mark received in tracking system. Note any partial payments.

steps.title: Send late notices (6th)
steps.instructions: For any tenant not paid by the 5th, send formal late notice per lease terms. Include late fee calculation. Send via email AND certified mail.

steps.title: Phone follow-up (10th)
steps.instructions: Call any tenant still delinquent. Document conversation. Offer payment plan only with owner approval. Note any disputes.

steps.title: Demand letter (15th)
steps.instructions: If still unpaid by the 15th, issue formal demand letter. Reference lease clause, state cure period, and consequences of non-payment.
steps.warning_note: Demand letter triggers legal clock — ensure proper delivery method

steps.title: Escalate to owner (20th)
steps.instructions: If still unresolved, brief owner with full timeline, amounts owed, and recommended next steps (payment plan, eviction, or negotiation).

steps.title: Update records
steps.instructions: Record all collection activity in tenant file. Update delinquency report. Calculate late fees accrued.

steps.title: Pull income summary
steps.instructions: Export rent roll from DoorLoop. Summarize: total collected, outstanding, late fees, and any credits applied.

steps.title: Compile expense summary
steps.instructions: List all property expenses for the month: maintenance, utilities, insurance, taxes, vendor payments, capital improvements.

steps.title: Occupancy status
steps.instructions: Report current occupancy rate, any move-ins/move-outs, lease renewals completed, and vacancy marketing status.

steps.title: Maintenance summary
steps.instructions: List all maintenance requests: opened, completed, and pending. Note any major repairs or capital items.

steps.title: Upcoming lease events
steps.instructions: List any leases expiring in next 90 days, renewal status, and any tenant issues requiring owner decision.

steps.title: Send report
steps.instructions: Compile into standard format. Send to owner by the 10th of each month. Flag any items requiring owner decision or approval.

steps.title: Assess condition
steps.instructions: Walk entire lot. Photograph all faded areas. Determine if full restripe or partial touch-up is needed.

steps.title: Get competitive bids
steps.instructions: Contact at least 2 striping vendors. Specify: 314 spaces per plat, 6 handicap, fire lanes, directional arrows, and lot numbers.

steps.title: Schedule work
steps.instructions: Schedule for lowest-traffic day (Tuesday or Wednesday). Require overnight cure time. Notify all tenants 1 week in advance.

steps.title: Coordinate tenant parking
steps.instructions: Provide alternate parking plan during striping. Lot 7 and Lot 8 available for overflow. Post temporary signage.

steps.title: Inspect completed work
steps.instructions: Walk entire lot after cure. Verify all markings are straight, correct color, and properly spaced. Check handicap compliance.

steps.title: Access roof safely
steps.instructions: Use fixed ladder at Unit 135B rear. Wear non-slip shoes. Do not access in rain, high wind, or lightning.
steps.warning_note: Never access roof alone — always have someone aware you are up there

steps.title: Walk long building membrane
steps.instructions: Walk the entire long building roof. Look for: ponding water, blisters, tears, exposed substrate, or debris accumulation.

steps.title: Check around RTUs
steps.instructions: Inspect flashing and curbs around each rooftop HVAC unit. These are the most common leak points. Note any separation or rust.

steps.title: Check Patricia building
steps.instructions: Walk the Patricia St building roof. Same inspection criteria. Pay attention to the Jasons Deli section (heaviest equipment).

steps.title: Check drains and scuppers
steps.instructions: Verify all roof drains are clear of debris. Check scuppers for blockage. Clear any leaves or buildup.

steps.title: Document and report
steps.instructions: Photograph any concerns. Compare to last months photos. If new damage found, call roofer within 48 hours.

steps.title: Schedule professional roofer
steps.instructions: Contact 2-3 commercial roofing companies. Get quotes for full inspection with written report. Schedule for dry weather.

steps.title: Provide property info
steps.instructions: Give roofer: building dimensions, roof type (modified bitumen/TPO), last repair dates, known problem areas from monthly inspections.

steps.title: Accompany inspector
steps.instructions: Be on-site during inspection. Point out areas of concern. Ask about remaining useful life and maintenance recommendations.

steps.title: Review written report
steps.instructions: Get detailed written report with photos. Should include: overall condition rating, problem areas, repair recommendations, and estimated costs.

steps.title: Budget repairs
steps.instructions: Add recommended repairs to capital budget. Prioritize by urgency. Get repair bids if immediate work needed.

steps.title: File and compare
steps.instructions: File report in property records. Compare to previous year. Track deterioration trends. Update reserve study if needed.

steps.title: Check ADA ramps and curb cuts
steps.instructions: Inspect all wheelchair ramps and curb cuts. Verify proper slope, no cracks, and detectable warning surfaces intact.
steps.warning_note: ADA non-compliance = federal liability

steps.title: Inspect trip hazards
steps.instructions: Walk all sidewalks checking for raised joints, cracked concrete, or uneven surfaces greater than 1/4 inch. Mark with paint if found.

steps.title: Check handrails
steps.instructions: Verify all handrails are secure, proper height (34-38 inches), and extend properly at top and bottom of stairs/ramps.

steps.title: Verify emergency exits
steps.instructions: Check all emergency exit doors open freely, are not blocked, and exit signs are illuminated.

steps.title: Check parking lot safety
steps.instructions: Verify speed bumps visible, stop signs in place, pedestrian crossings marked, and sight lines clear at intersections.

steps.title: Document and prioritize
steps.instructions: Photograph all deficiencies. Prioritize: immediate safety hazard (24hr fix), ADA issue (1 week), cosmetic (30 days).

steps.title: List all active vendors
steps.instructions: Pull the current vendor list. Include: landscaping, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, pest control, waste, cleaning, roofing.

steps.title: Rate each vendor (1-5)
steps.instructions: Score each vendor on: Response time, Work quality, Pricing fairness, Communication, Reliability. Use specific examples.

steps.title: Document issues
steps.instructions: Note any missed appointments, callbacks needed, billing disputes, or quality complaints from this quarter.

steps.title: Identify replacements needed
steps.instructions: Any vendor scoring below 3.0 average should be flagged for replacement. Get 2 competitive bids.

steps.title: Update vendor records
steps.instructions: Record scores in vendor management system. Note any contract renewal dates approaching.

steps.title: Check pylon sign
steps.instructions: Verify all 14 panels are lit and readable. Note any burned-out bulbs, faded panels, or physical damage. Check timer is set correctly.

steps.title: Walk tenant storefront signs
steps.instructions: Check each tenant sign for: illumination working, no missing letters, clean condition, matches approved sign plan.

steps.title: Check directional signage
steps.instructions: Verify all directional signs (entrance, exit, one-way, speed limit, handicap) are visible, not faded, and properly mounted.

steps.title: Inspect parking lot lights
steps.instructions: Check all pole-mounted lights. Note any that are out, flickering, or have damaged fixtures. Check photocell operation (on at dusk, off at dawn).

steps.title: Check building-mounted lights
steps.instructions: Walk under the canopy/soffit. Verify all recessed and wall-mounted lights are working. Note any water intrusion around fixtures.

steps.title: Submit work orders
steps.instructions: Create maintenance requests for any lighting or signage issues. Priority: safety lighting (24hr), tenant signs (72hr), cosmetic (1 week).

steps.title: Assist the injured person
steps.instructions: Ask if they need medical attention. Call 911 if injury appears serious. Do NOT move them if back/neck injury suspected.
steps.warning_note: NEVER say I am sorry this happened or we should have fixed that

steps.title: Secure the area
steps.instructions: Place cones or barriers around the area. If wet floor caused it, mop immediately but photograph FIRST. Prevent others from same hazard.

steps.title: Document the scene
steps.instructions: Photograph exact spot of fall, surrounding conditions, footwear of person, any contributing factors. Wide and close shots.

steps.title: Collect information
steps.instructions: Get from injured: full name, phone, address, description of what happened. Get from witnesses: name, phone, what they saw.

steps.title: Notify insurance immediately
steps.instructions: Call insurance carrier same day. Provide all documentation. Get claim number. Do not discuss with injured party beyond initial assistance.
steps.warning_note: Report within 24 hours — late reporting can void coverage

steps.title: Walk all parking rows
steps.instructions: Inspect every striped line in the main field. Note any that are faded beyond 50% visibility.

steps.title: Check handicap markings
steps.instructions: Verify all handicap symbols, access aisles, and Van Accessible markings are clearly visible. These are highest priority.
steps.warning_note: Faded handicap markings = ADA liability

steps.title: Check fire lanes
steps.instructions: Verify fire lane markings and No Parking - Fire Lane text are clearly visible. Check curb paint.

steps.title: Check directional arrows
steps.instructions: Verify all directional arrows and lane markings are visible. Check stop bars at intersections.

steps.title: Document and bid
steps.instructions: If restriping needed, photograph problem areas. Get bids from 2 vendors. Schedule for lowest-traffic period (typically Tuesday/Wednesday).

steps.title: Receive assessment notice
steps.instructions: Review annual property tax assessment from Lafayette Parish Assessor. Note assessed value and any changes from prior year.

steps.title: Compare to market value
steps.instructions: Compare assessed value to: recent comparable sales, income approach (NOI / cap rate), and replacement cost. Document analysis.

steps.title: Determine protest merit
steps.instructions: If assessed value exceeds reasonable market value by 15%+, protest is warranted. Prepare supporting evidence.

steps.title: File protest if applicable
steps.instructions: File protest with Lafayette Parish Board of Review by deadline. Include: comparable sales, income analysis, and any physical condition issues.
steps.warning_note: Protest deadline is strict — miss it and you wait another year

steps.title: Update tenant NNN estimates
steps.instructions: Once final tax amount is known, update tenant pro-rata tax estimates for next billing cycle.

steps.title: Empty all exterior trash cans
steps.instructions: Replace bags in all 8 exterior trash receptacles. Wipe down lids if sticky or dirty.

steps.title: Sweep breezeway
steps.instructions: Sweep the covered breezeway from east to west. Remove leaves, cigarette butts, and any litter.

steps.title: Check restrooms
steps.instructions: Verify soap, paper towels, and toilet paper are stocked. Check for plumbing issues. Wipe counters. Mop if visibly dirty.

steps.title: Wipe benches and surfaces
steps.instructions: Wipe down all outdoor benches and any shared surfaces with disinfectant.

steps.title: Check planters
steps.instructions: Remove any trash from planters. Note dead plants for landscaping vendor.

steps.title: Identify unauthorized vehicle
steps.instructions: Note: no tenant permit, parked 48+ hours, blocking fire lane, in reserved/handicap without placard, or abandoned (flat tires, expired tags).

steps.title: Photograph and document
steps.instructions: Photograph vehicle from 4 angles showing license plate, location, any damage, parking violation. Note date, time, and specific violation.

steps.title: Place warning sticker
steps.instructions: Apply 24-hour warning sticker to driver window. Sticker must state violation, deadline to move, tow company info, property management contact.
steps.warning_note: Fire lane violations can be towed immediately — no warning required

steps.title: Call tow company after deadline
steps.instructions: If vehicle still present after 24 hours (or immediately for fire lane): call contracted tow company. Stay on-site until towed.

steps.title: Log the tow
steps.instructions: Record in tow log: date, time, vehicle info, violation type, tow company, where towed to. Keep copy of tow receipt.

steps.title: Document the violation
steps.instructions: Photograph or video the violation. Note: date, time, specific lease clause violated, and how long it has been occurring.

steps.title: Identify lease clause
steps.instructions: Pull the tenants lease. Identify the specific section being violated. Note the cure period specified in the lease (typically 10-30 days).

steps.title: Draft cure notice
steps.instructions: Write formal notice citing: specific violation, lease clause, required corrective action, and deadline to cure.

steps.title: Deliver notice properly
steps.instructions: Deliver per lease requirements: typically certified mail AND hand delivery (or posting on door). Get proof of delivery.
steps.warning_note: Improper delivery can invalidate the notice — follow lease delivery requirements exactly

steps.title: Monitor cure period
steps.instructions: Check daily whether tenant has corrected the violation. Document progress or continued non-compliance.

steps.title: Follow up or escalate
steps.instructions: If cured: document and close. If not cured by deadline: consult with owner on next steps (second notice, lease termination, or legal action).

steps.title: Collect W-9
steps.instructions: Request completed W-9 form. Verify legal name and tax ID match. File for year-end 1099 reporting.

steps.title: Verify insurance
steps.instructions: Request COI showing: general liability ($1M minimum), workers comp (if applicable), and auto insurance. Belle Realty as additional insured.
steps.warning_note: Do NOT allow work to begin without verified insurance

steps.title: Execute vendor agreement
steps.instructions: Have vendor sign standard service agreement covering: scope, rates, payment terms, insurance requirements, and termination clause.

steps.title: Set up in payment system
steps.instructions: Add vendor to accounting system with: legal name, address, payment terms, and preferred payment method (check or ACH).

steps.title: Provide property access
steps.instructions: Issue any needed keys, gate codes, or access instructions. Provide: property map, emergency contacts, and after-hours procedures.

steps.title: Add to vendor directory
steps.instructions: Enter vendor in the property management system with: company name, contact, phone, email, service type, and contract details.

steps.title: Compile vendor list
steps.instructions: List all vendors used in the past year: name, service type, total spend, number of service calls, and contract status.

steps.title: Score each vendor
steps.instructions: Rate 1-5 on: response time, work quality, pricing, communication, reliability, and professionalism. Use specific examples from the year.

steps.title: Review pricing competitiveness
steps.instructions: Compare each vendors rates to market. Get 1-2 competitive quotes for your highest-spend categories.

steps.title: Identify issues and wins
steps.instructions: Document: any callbacks, disputes, missed appointments, or quality issues. Also note exceptional service worth rewarding.

steps.title: Make retention decisions
steps.instructions: For each vendor: retain, renegotiate, or replace. Get owner approval for any vendor changes.

steps.title: Execute changes
steps.instructions: For replacements: onboard new vendor, transition work, terminate old contract per terms. For renegotiations: present data and propose new terms.

steps.title: Start at Unit 101 (Johnston end)
steps.instructions: Begin at the western end of the long building. Walk east, checking each storefront systematically.

steps.title: Check window displays
steps.instructions: Verify windows are clean, displays are professional, no unapproved signage taped to glass. Note any violations.

steps.title: Check exterior merchandise
steps.instructions: No merchandise, racks, or displays outside the lease line without written approval. Photograph any violations.
steps.warning_note: Exterior merchandise without approval = lease violation

steps.title: Verify signage compliance
steps.instructions: Each tenant sign must match the approved sign criteria. No temporary signs, banners, or A-frames without approval.

steps.title: Check Patricia building
steps.instructions: Continue to the Patricia St building (135A through 149). Same inspection criteria for each unit.

steps.title: Document and follow up
steps.instructions: Photograph all violations. Send friendly reminder email for first offense. Formal notice for repeat violations. Log in system.

steps.title: Compile property rules document
steps.instructions: Include operating hours, noise policy, signage criteria, parking rules, trash/recycling schedule, common area use, pet policy, smoking policy.

steps.title: Add emergency contacts
steps.instructions: Include management office, after-hours emergency line, fire department, police non-emergency, utility companies (LUS), preferred vendors.

steps.title: Include maintenance requirements
steps.instructions: Detail tenant responsibilities: HVAC filter changes monthly, grease trap pumping if food, pest control, storefront cleanliness, sign maintenance.

steps.title: Add insurance and compliance requirements
steps.instructions: List COI requirements and deadline, occupational license, W-9, ACH form for rent payment, any industry-specific permits needed.

steps.title: Include parking map and unit info
steps.instructions: Provide property map with their unit highlighted, assigned parking if any, dumpster location, utility meter locations, key/access information.

steps.title: Deliver and confirm receipt
steps.instructions: Deliver packet in person during move-in walkthrough. Have tenant sign acknowledgment of receipt. File signed copy.
